title: Bounded flat Cech model with a finite-free upper-bounded resolution
statement: Let f:X→T be proper and finitely presented [def-pc-morphism-conventions], and F a finitely presented O_X-module flat over T. For every t∈T there exist an open U containing t, a natural number d and complexes C,Q of O_U-modules [def-pc-derived-category] such that C vanishes outside [0,d], every C^n is flat over U, Q vanishes above d, every Q^n is finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and there is a quasi-isomorphism Q→C. For every cartesian base change to T′→U, the homology of the ordinary pullback of C in degree q≥0 is isomorphic to R^q f′_*F′. Q is permitted infinitely many negative terms; C is not required finite free.

proof.text: Construct the bounded nonnegative quasi-coherent flat complex and its base-change comparison by finite affine Čech descent.
On the affine neighbourhood, apply the finite-free resolution theorem to obtain Q and a quasi-isomorphism Q to C.
